title: Be well
body: I don’t mean to write bad things, I actually like the app - it’s pleasant to the eye, it’s great for setting goals and it’s made like a game. That being said it’s riddled with issues - I’ve had days where the communication with the watch is nonexistent, achievements and badges contradict each other and recently the time of the exercise shown on the watch and the registered time in the actual app are not the same usually when I go for a walk. I’ve noticed only bad reviews, apparently nobody cares. Please care, we love you very much. We buy your products and we’ll love it if they work properly. Thank you!
